title: SanaCkoala
description:
[b]SanaCkoala[/b] adds two playable characters to Slay the Spire 2, the Koala and the Panda, plus one more who is waiting to be found. They all work in singleplayer, and they are built to play well together in co-op.

[h2]The Koala[/h2]
70 HP. Starter relic: [b]Eucalyptus Leaf[/b] (start each combat with 3 Drowsy). Touch of Orobas upgrades it to [b]Eucalyptus Crown[/b] (6 Drowsy).
[list]
[*][b]Drowsy[/b]: at the end of your turn, gain Block equal to your Drowsy.
[*][b]Waking up[/b]: some cards remove all of your Drowsy at once for a big effect.
[*]Three ways to play: build a Hibernation Fortress that stays Drowsy; bank Drowsy for an Alarm Burst; or manage a hand of Dream and Retain cards.
[/list]

[h2]The Panda[/h2]
80 HP. Starter relic: [b]Bamboo Basket[/b] (start each combat with 3 Bamboo). Touch of Orobas upgrades it to [b]Bamboo Hamper[/b] (6 Bamboo).
[list]
[*][b]Bamboo[/b] is a resource you gather with cards and powers.
[*][b]Munch N[/b]: if you have at least N Bamboo, the card spends it and triggers a bonus effect.
[*][b]Full[/b]: your first Munch each turn gives one Full, which feeds the menu, belly and Roll cards.
[*]Four ways to play: Full menu choices, Block and counterattacks, multi-hit Strength turns, or building and spending Roll momentum.
[/list]

[h2]???[/h2]
Something is waiting at the top of the Spire. Take the Koala and the Panda up there and see who shows up.

Each character has 87 cards (3 Basic, 20 Common, 36 Uncommon, 26 Rare and 2 Ancient), the same split as the vanilla characters. Each also has seven relics on top of the starter relic, and three potions.

[h2]Ancient cards and events[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Archaic Tooth[/b] turns Doze into Deep Sleep and Gather Bamboo into Bamboo Harvest.
[*][b]Dusty Tome[/b] gives the Koala Lazy Sunday and the Panda Rolling Thunder.
[*]Twelve events appear only in runs with the Koala or the Panda, such as The Last Dumpling, Eucalyptus Tollbooth, Dream Exchange and The Summit Picnic.
[*]Two enchantments come from these events: [b]Well-Rested[/b] (a Retained card gives Block) and [b]Freshly-Cut[/b] (a Panda card that Munches gives a short damage boost).
[/list]

[h2]Co-op content[/h2]
In multiplayer runs, both characters start with [b]Hold Hands[/b], and five more colorless cards can appear: [b]Share a Bite[/b], [b]Quarrel[/b], [b]Make Up[/b], [b]Assist[/b] and [b]Promise[/b]. The Koala has five co-op cards of its own and the Panda has seven, such as [b]Wake-Up Kiss[/b], [b]Pajama Party[/b], [b]Piggyback Charge[/b] and [b]Partner in Crime[/b]. Each character also has a co-op relic, three shared relics can drop, and several events need a second player. Co-op cards that give resources target one ally you choose. None of this shows up in singleplayer.

[h2]Memory Album[/h2]
A [b]Memory Album[/b] button on the main menu opens an achievement album: 48 achievements on six pages. 37 can be earned in singleplayer; the other 11 need a co-op run with any teammate.
[list]
[*]Bronze, Silver and Gold achievements worth 1, 2 and 3 points, 94 in total. Counting ones show a progress bar, and three are hidden.
[*]A banner with the medal when you earn one, a red dot on the album button, and new entries that pop in when you open the album.
[*]The end-of-run screen shows what you earned that run and what is close.
[*]New album backgrounds and a menu pin at 20, 45, 70 and 94 points, and titles from Gold achievements.
[*]Keepsakes only: achievements never change cards, rewards, events or combat.
[/list]

[h2]Installation[/h2]
[list]
[*]Requires [b]BaseLib[/b]. Steam asks you to subscribe to it as well.
[*]Subscribe and start the game. The first time, the game asks whether to load mods; allow it.
[*]For multiplayer, every player needs this mod on the same version.
[*]Do not also keep a manual copy in the game's [i]mods[/i] folder.
[*]Unlocks and achievements are saved in the mod's own progress file for each player, not in the game save.
[*]Modded play uses a separate set of save files. Your unmodded saves are not touched. On a fresh modded save, the mod still starts act 1 with Neow.
[/list]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Tested on game version v0.107.1 only. Other versions may not load.

Source code and full README: [url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-duo]GitHub[/url]

Fan-made mod, not affiliated with or endorsed by Mega Crit. Card art, icons and character images made with AI image generation.
changeNote:
[b]v1.1.0[/b]
[list]
[*]New [b]Memory Album[/b] button on the main menu: an achievement album with 48 achievements on six pages (Journey, Koala, Panda, a hidden page, Together, Keepsakes). 37 can be earned in singleplayer; 11 need a co-op run, with any teammate and any characters.
[*]Achievements are Bronze, Silver or Gold (1, 2 or 3 points, 94 in total). Counting ones show a progress bar and say "Almost there" at 70%. Three are hidden until earned.
[*]Earning one shows a banner with its medal at the top of the screen. The album button gets a red dot, and new entries pop in the next time you open the album.
[*]One page stays hidden until you find who it belongs to.
[*]The victory and defeat screens now have a small panel listing up to three achievements earned that run and up to three that are close. After a loss it adds a short note and picture.
[*]At 20, 45, 70 and 94 points the album gets a new background and a pin appears next to the album button. Gold achievements give a title shown at the top of the album.
[*]New art: 27 album pictures, a card back, 18 medals, 4 pins and 4 album backgrounds.
[*]Achievements are keepsakes only and never change cards, rewards, events or combat. They are earned for the whole party and saved in each player's own progress file.
[/list]

[b]v1.0.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Someone new is waiting at the top of the Spire. Reach it with the Koala and the Panda to find out who. The unlock is saved in each player's own mod progress file; game saves are not changed.
[*]Card art is now compressed. The download is about 62 MB instead of 197 MB, with no visible change in game.
[/list]
Every player needs to update before playing together.
Source and details: [url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-duo]GitHub[/url]

[b]v1.1.0[/b]
[list]
[*]主選單新增[b]回憶相簿[/b]按鈕：一本成就相簿，48 個成就分成 6 頁（旅途、無尾熊、熊貓、一個隱藏頁、同行、收藏）。37 個單人就拿得到，11 個要在多人對局達成，隊友是誰、玩什麼角色都算。
[*]成就分銅牌、銀牌、金牌（1、2、3 點，共 94 點）。要累計次數的成就有進度條，做到 70% 會標上「快完成了」。有 3 個隱藏成就，達成前看不到內容。
[*]達成成就時，畫面上方會跳出帶獎牌的提示；相簿按鈕會亮紅點，下次打開相簿時新的格子會跳出來。
[*]有一頁會保持隱藏，直到你找到它的主人。
[*]勝利和失敗畫面多了一個小面板，列出這局拿到的成就（最多 3 個）和快完成的成就（最多 3 個）；輸掉時會多一張圖和一句話。
[*]點數到 20、45、70、94 點時，相簿會換新背景，相簿按鈕旁會出現一枚別針。金牌成就會給一個稱號，顯示在相簿最上方。
[*]新美術：27 張相簿照片、卡背、18 枚獎牌、4 枚別針、4 張相簿背景。
[*]成就只做紀念，不會改變卡牌、獎勵、事件或戰鬥。成就由全隊共享，存在每位玩家各自的進度檔。
[/list]

[b]v1.0.0[/b]
[list]
[*]塔頂上有新的誰在等。帶無尾熊和熊貓爬上去，就知道是誰了。解鎖紀錄存在每位玩家各自的 mod 進度檔，不會改到遊戲存檔。
[*]卡圖改成壓縮格式，下載量從 197 MB 降到約 62 MB，遊戲內看不出差別。
[/list]
多人連線前，每位玩家都要先更新。
原始碼與詳細說明：[url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-duo]GitHub[/url]
